summary: Iteration 20 — Quote Calculator fixes fully verified. Pricing unit tests (12/12) pass: overMiles/mileageOverage math correct, hard 6-hour minHours floor applied in computeQuote itself, crewCharge uses effectiveHours (4*6*65=1560), hours>=minHours untouched, deposit = round(final*25)/100, finalQuote > subtotal (cushion folded in) and rounds up to $50. Backend round-trip test passed: PUT/GET /api/quotes/recQATESTLEAD1 persists breakdown.crew=4 and breakdown.hours=6.5; mongo doc cleaned up in teardown. UI on /calculator (owner): mileage line 'Mileage — 80 mi beyond the first 20 × $0.85/mi' shows $68.00 with miles=100 and disappears with miles=15; Travel fee label reads 'Travel fee (covers first 20 miles)'; no line-cushion testid and no 'Cushion' line inside the quote breakdown (only appears in the right-side Script Panel surcharge reference, expected); Subtotal/Final Quote/Deposit(25%)/Balance all render with Final > Subtotal; crew charge line updates live with hours. Code review confirmed leadActions.bookLeadAsJob maps breakdown.crew -> PF.crewSize and breakdown.hours -> PF.estHours into the created projects record before create; Calculator.jsx and QuoteModal.jsx both save {crew:Number(crew), hours:q.hours (effective floored)} via saveQuoteBreakdownApi and both derive minHours from 3BR/4BR+ lead size.
critical_code_review_comments: pricing.js effectiveHours floor is applied at math level (not just prefill) - correct.
Calculator.jsx/QuoteModal.jsx both pass q.hours (effective floored hours) to saveQuoteBreakdownApi, ensuring downstream Book-as-job reads the correct hours.
leadActions.bookLeadAsJob fetches getQuoteBreakdownApi and injects crew/hours before createRecord - crew size + estHours will now persist onto Project.
No 'Cushion' line item in QuoteLines (Calculator.jsx L42-99); cushion is only folded into finalQuote via rounding math.
